key_insight: LLM4EHR aligns ICU EHR event sequences with time-series signals using a domain-adapted LLM plus a transformer encoder to learn more transferable clinical representations.
clinical_relevance: This could improve downstream ICU prediction models by capturing shared temporal structure across heterogeneous EHR data and adapting better to new patient cohorts.
method: Pre-train on ICU EHR event sequences and time-series data.
Use a domain-adapted large language model to embed medical events.
Train with a regularised contrastive objective to align event and time-series representations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports ablation studies showing improved downstream clinical task performance and k-shot transferability of the learned time-series embeddings.
watch_item: Results are based on ICU EHR data, so external validation is needed before assuming the same gains in other settings or institutions.
paper_title: LLM4EHR: Aligning Clinical Time Series with Medical Event Sequences via Large Language Models
